x: Clive Shippen and Eric Gebbett had a tremendous tussle with Alexander of Highgate in the latter stages and with half a mile to go appeared to have won the day, for Clive had put in a fast finish to break we[illegible] away and Eric was chasing hard.

Title holders Steve White (21.7) and Lee Sullivan (21'-9½") had no difficulty in holding on to their number one positions in the Senior ranks, but Arnold Bent relinquished his high jump title to rival Alexander who won on the count back---both clearing 5'-9¾".
Congratulations to Matthew, Steven, Alexander, Aaron, Dan W., Robert, all gaining representative honours. 13th OCTOBER 1984 WIMBLEDON COMMON SURREY LEAGUE (1) 2¼ MILES
